## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: release — docs/design/release/release.md; system — docs/design/system/system.md; design — docs/design/design/design.md; published-skill-first-release-amendment — specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md. Exact current package and governing subjects are stored.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r7, current approved direction.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r6, round 6.
- Material findings: none new; earlier findings retain their resolved historical dispositions.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded through targeted operation on successful save.
- Open blockers: none at Design scope.
- Immediate next stage: authorized Delivery allocation/review for the bounded post-closeout slice; no direct implementation or activity mutation by this review.
- Claim limitations: this approves the exact scoped contract amendment only. Earlier Verify is not refreshed, and no current tests, final closeout, PR readiness or publication success are claimed.

## Scoped command retirement assessment

The revised Standalone command disposition selects only scripts/validate-release-ci.py for withdrawal and identifies the canonical replacement invocation: python scripts/validate-release.py --recorded-source-auto --version <tag>. Inspection of the current wrapper confirms its entire behavior is forwarding the caller arguments after --recorded-source-auto and returning the canonical command result. It owns no independent validation algorithm, recorded-source interpretation or publication authority.

The current selector's release.validate command already uses the canonical recorded-source invocation. Its recognition of the deleted wrapper path can remain as deletion-impact selection without retaining executable compatibility. The existing canonical recorded-commit regression and direct recorded-source mode tests retain substantive protection; only the test whose purpose is verifying this withdrawn wrapper's delegation is selected for deletion. This is a deliberate entrypoint withdrawal with a named replacement, not a claim that useful validation can be removed because its wrapper is short.

The retained stop-tracking-generated-public-adapter-skill-bodies.test.md reference to the three original script paths concerns the historical v0.1.3 proof that archive validation does not depend on tracked generated adapter trees. That protected behavior remains current through canonical validation; the historical list is not a perpetual alias-availability guarantee. The owning current Release amendment supplies the precise later disposition, while old executions/judgments keep their original meaning. No separate Distribution model or broad test-spec rewrite is required for this bounded alias decision.

Preparation/check mode, cheap preflight diagnostics and separately authorized historical/exceptional public-evidence closeout remain distinct recurring capabilities. Keeping prepare-release.py, release-preflight.py and close-release-publication.py preserves those entry paths without turning them into routine manual coordination or authorizing publication. Their shared implementation and the routine coordinator remain separate from the withdrawn redundant alias. release-verify.sh and validate-release.py remain substantive current consumers.

## Complete-package coherence and current reliance

The amendment changes Release's implementation inventory, the exact standalone-command contract and its Compatibility/migration scenario. That scenario explicitly requires canonical recorded-source mode and recorded-commit validation to survive the wrapper retirement. System's existing owner relationships, Design's retention rules and the scoped R7/R8 protective obligations remain coherent. Prior complete independent assessment remains applicable to the unchanged requirements, decisions, one-approval workflow, candidate/overlay identity, timing consequence, source maps and remaining scenarios. The added disposition preserves REL-SR-06/09/14/19/21 protections and does not select another public product capability, broad script cleanup or publication work.

This Design judgment relies on the current explicit command disposition and preserved protection, not on continued checkout presence of the retired wrapper after authorized implementation. The inspected wrapper body and current caller facts establish the selection basis; milestone Code Review and final Verify must establish the actual deletion, canonical protection and consumer reconciliation. Earlier exact review subjects/judgments remain unchanged and do not become approvals of replacement content. The prior six-document source-retirement reliance disposition remains unchanged.

The reported hosted test-fixture failure is not waived by this approval. Its safe fixture correction, actual test results, implementation judgment and integrated proof belong to the newly allocated Delivery/implementation/Code Review/Verify scope. This reviewer has not independently diagnosed that failure or claimed it unrelated to all required proof. It does not require inventing a production behavior change in this Design merely to make a test pass.

## Independence and checks

The same original independent reviewer did not author the amendment or edit code. Read the exact Release delta, full small wrapper, relevant canonical recorded-source tests and selector command/path handling, and the retained historical test-spec reference. Current primary context and subject inspection provide exact package/governing identities. Proposal Review r7 supplies independent current direction authority. No project-map or repository-wide conformance claim is used.

Commands actually used: git diff/status, cat scripts/validate-release-ci.py, bounded rg/sed reads of canonical validation, wrapper/canonical tests, selector/workflow references and the historical v0.1.3 test specification; primary context/subject inspect and targeted recording. No runtime regression or release command was run. Record-store validation and git diff --check follow the save and establish persistence/hygiene only. No engineering, activity/work, commit or external mutation was made by this reviewer.
independence_basis: Original independent nonauthor reviewer assessed the author-owned standalone-command amendment and exact current package, without editing engineering or routing.
